scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Haruto Tanaka and I'm 42. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Haruto, I'm sorry to hear about this concern regarding an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to investigate this for you. To ensure I'm looking at the correct account, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of the phone number associated with your profile?
Sure, my account number is 8842-9910 and my phone number ends in 4492.

Thank you for verifying that. I have pulled up your account. I see the transaction for $76.00 dated two days ago at 'Global Tech Services'. Does that merchant name sound familiar, or is it completely unrecognized?
No, I've never heard of Global Tech Services. I definitely didn't buy anything from them.

I appreciate you confirming that. Per our Security and Fraud Policy, since you do not recognize the merchant and have confirmed you did not authorize the transaction, I have initiated a formal dispute for this charge. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity.
Oh, that's a relief. Does this mean I get the money back?

Yes, I have processed a provisional credit for the $76.00, which will appear in your account within 24 hours while the investigation into the merchant is completed. You will receive a new card in the mail within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized nature of the transaction, initiated a formal dispute, issued a provisional credit, and secured the account by blocking the compromised card.
